# Idea for shaman quest

## Post 9073 by Mrkrissatan (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2021-01-11T20:59:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=9073#p9073 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I think Shamans should have a quest for a weapon at level 30 similar to the warrior whirlwind weapon questline, all my ideas are posted below, any feedback or help is welcome as I don't really know how to use the quest creator.

So after getting the Totem of Air our mighty hero receives their first quest
[Air of Power](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
during which the Shaman will scour the shimmering flats for 30
[Air Vortex](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

Bath'rah the Windwatcher will then send the player to Scarlet Monestary Armoury and Razorfen Kraul
<https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!%20to%20put%20your%20faith%20in>
there they will obtain [Razorfen Totem](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) and [Light Forged Ingot](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

upon returning to him the totems have to be cleansed and require the shaman to fight three waves of imps (I have no idea how to even attempt to do this quest)

Bath'rah the Windwatcher will then forge one of four weapons for the Shaman

Rewards (choose one)

[Stormbringer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Lightning's Edge](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Storm Rod](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Thunder Shank](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
